class SnowflakeTableChangeTrigger(Component):
    display_name = "Table Change Trigger"
    description = "Trigger this flow when rows change in a Snowflake table"
    icon = "Snowflake"
    name = "SnowflakeTableChangeTrigger"

    inputs = [
        TabInput(
            name="status_mode",
            display_name="Status",
            options=STATUS_MODE_OPTIONS,
            value="Active",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="database",
            display_name="Database",
            options=get_trigger_databases(),
            value="SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="schema",
            display_name="Schema",
            options=get_trigger_schemas("SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW"),
            value="CORE",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="source_object",
            display_name="Table or View",
            options=get_trigger_table_or_view_objects("SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW", "CORE"),
            value="CUSTOMER_ORDERS",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            combobox=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="trigger_on",
            display_name="Trigger On",
            options=TABLE_TRIGGER_ON_OPTIONS,
            value="New Rows Only (Insert)",
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_batch_rows",
            display_name="Max Batch Rows",
            value=100,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="show_initial_rows",
            display_name="Show Initial Rows",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="compute_mode",
            display_name="Compute Mode",
            options=COMPUTE_MODE_OPTIONS,
            value="Serverless (Managed)",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="warehouse",
            display_name="Warehouse",
            options=get_trigger_warehouses(),
            value="COMPUTE_WH",
            combobox=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="retry_attempts",
            display_name="Task Auto Retry Attempts",
            value=3,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="suspend_after_failures",
            display_name="Suspend After Failures",
            value=5,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="timeout_ms",
            display_name="Timeout (ms)",
            value=3600000,
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Changed Rows",
            name="changed_rows",
            method="build_changed_rows",
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="Trigger Message",
            name="trigger_message_out",
            method="build_trigger_message",
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="Stream Metadata",
            name="stream_metadata",
            method="build_stream_metadata",
        ),
    ]

    def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dict[str, Any], field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        flow_id = resolve_trigger_flow_id(self, build_config)
        if "database" in build_config:
            build_config["database"]["options"] = get_trigger_databases(flow_id=flow_id)
            if field_name == "database" and isinstance(field_value, str):
                build_config["database"]["value"] = field_value

        db_val = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "database" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("database", {}).get("value") or "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW"
        )
        schemas = get_trigger_schemas(db_val, flow_id=flow_id)
        if "schema" in build_config:
            build_config["schema"]["options"] = schemas
            cur_sch = build_config["schema"].get("value")
            if field_name == "schema" and isinstance(field_value, str):
                build_config["schema"]["value"] = field_value
            else:
                _sel.keep_or_default(build_config, "schema", schemas, field_name)

        sch_val = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "schema" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("schema", {}).get("value") or (schemas[0] if schemas else "CORE")
        )
        if "source_object" in build_config:
            obj_opts = get_trigger_table_or_view_objects(db_val, sch_val, flow_id=flow_id)
            cur_src = build_config["source_object"].get("value")
            if field_name == "source_object" and isinstance(field_value, str):
                build_config["source_object"]["value"] = field_value
                if field_value and field_value not in obj_opts:
                    obj_opts = [field_value, *obj_opts]
            elif (field_name in ("database", "schema") or not cur_src) and obj_opts and cur_src not in obj_opts:
                build_config["source_object"]["value"] = obj_opts[0]
            build_config["source_object"]["options"] = obj_opts

        cmode = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "compute_mode" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("compute_mode", {}).get("value") or "Serverless (Managed)"
        )
        if "warehouse" in build_config:
            build_config["warehouse"]["options"] = get_trigger_warehouses(flow_id=flow_id)
            build_config["warehouse"]["show"] = cmode == "Warehouse"
        get_triggers_manager().sync_trigger_from_build_config(
            component_type=self.name,
            component=self,
            build_config=build_config,
            field_name=field_name,
            field_value=field_value,
            bridge=LIVE_BRIDGE,
        )
        return build_config

    def _provision_and_get_spec(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        flow_id = resolve_trigger_flow_id(self)
        db = str(getattr(self, "database", "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW") or "SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW").strip()
        sch = str(getattr(self, "schema", "CORE") or "CORE").strip()
        src = str(getattr(self, "source_object", "CUSTOMER_ORDERS") or "CUSTOMER_ORDERS").strip()
        obj_kind = getattr(self, "object_kind", None) or detect_source_object_kind(db, sch, src, flow_id=flow_id)
        ddl_spec = build_table_change_trigger_ddl(
            flow_id=flow_id,
            database=db,
            schema=sch,
            source_object=src,
            object_kind=str(obj_kind),
            status_mode=getattr(self, "status_mode", "Active"),
            trigger_on=getattr(self, "trigger_on", "New Rows Only (Insert)"),
            max_batch_rows=int(getattr(self, "max_batch_rows", 100) or 100),
            show_initial_rows=bool(getattr(self, "show_initial_rows", False)),
            compute_mode=getattr(self, "compute_mode", "Serverless (Managed)"),
            warehouse=getattr(self, "warehouse", "COMPUTE_WH"),
            retry_attempts=int(getattr(self, "retry_attempts", 3) if getattr(self, "retry_attempts", None) is not None else 3),
            suspend_after_failures=int(
                getattr(self, "suspend_after_failures", 5)
                if getattr(self, "suspend_after_failures", None) is not None
                else 5
            ),
            timeout_ms=int(getattr(self, "timeout_ms", 3600000) or 3600000),
        )
        node_id = str(getattr(self, "_id", None) or getattr(self, "id", None) or "SnowflakeTableChangeTrigger")
        run = active_trigger_run(flow_id)
        if run is not None:
            # BUG-TRG-04: Snowflake fired this run, so the trigger already exists: never re-provision it,
            # expose the incoming RUN_LANGFLOW_FLOW payload as this component's outputs instead.
            rows = run["payload"].get("rows")
            self._trigger_rows = list(rows) if isinstance(rows, list) else []
            return {**ddl_spec, "provision_result": {"ok": True, "skipped": "trigger_run"}, "trigger_payload": run["payload"]}
        prov = get_triggers_manager().provision_trigger(
            ddl_spec=ddl_spec,
            node_id=node_id,
            bridge=LIVE_BRIDGE,
            config={
                "compute_mode": getattr(self, "compute_mode", "Serverless (Managed)"),
                "warehouse": getattr(self, "warehouse", "COMPUTE_WH"),
                "source_object": src,
                "trigger_on": getattr(self, "trigger_on", "New Rows Only (Insert)"),
            },
        )
        return {**ddl_spec, "provision_result": prov}

    def build_changed_rows(self) -> DataFrame:
        spec = self._provision_and_get_spec()
        injected_rows = getattr(self, "_trigger_rows", None)
        if isinstance(injected_rows, list):
            return DataFrame(injected_rows)
        limit = max(1, min(1000, int(getattr(self, "max_batch_rows", 100) or 100)))
        # PASSO3: the stream this trigger provisioned is usable by the flow when its schema is in context.
        _register_component_object(spec["stream_fqn"], "streams")
        res = _flow_component_execute_sql(f"SELECT * FROM {spec['stream_fqn']} LIMIT {limit}")
        return DataFrame(res.get("rows", []))

    def build_trigger_message(self) -> Message:
        spec = self._provision_and_get_spec()
        rows = getattr(self, "_trigger_rows", None)
        cnt = len(rows) if isinstance(rows, list) else 0
        text = (
            f"Snowflake Stream '{spec['stream_fqn']}' detected {cnt} changed row(s) on {spec['source_object_fqn']}."
        )
        return Message(
            text=text,
            trigger_type="STREAM_TRIGGER_RUN",
            source_object=spec["source_object_fqn"],
            stream_fqn=spec["stream_fqn"],
            task_fqn=spec["task_fqn"],
            row_count=cnt,
        )

    def build_stream_metadata(self) -> Data:
        spec = self._provision_and_get_spec()
        return Data(
            data={
                "trigger_component": "SnowflakeTableChangeTrigger",
                "trigger_type": "STREAM_TRIGGER_RUN",
                "flow_id": spec["flow_id"],
                "flow_short_id": spec["flow_short_id"],
                "database": spec["database"],
                "schema": spec["schema"],
                "source_object": spec["source_object"],
                "source_object_fqn": spec["source_object_fqn"],
                "stream_name": spec["stream_name"],
                "stream_fqn": spec["stream_fqn"],
                "task_name": spec["task_name"],
                "task_fqn": spec["task_fqn"],
                "temp_batch_fqn": spec["temp_batch_fqn"],
                "status_mode": spec["status_mode"],
                "active_role": LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role,
                "create_stream_sql": spec["create_stream_sql"],
                "create_task_sql": spec["create_task_sql"],
                "alter_state_sql": spec["alter_state_sql"],
                "ddl": spec["ddl"],
                "statements": spec["statements"],
            }
        )

            name="estimate_tokens",
            display_name="Estimate Tokens via AI_COUNT_TOKENS",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Result Message", name="message", method="run_ai_function"),
        Output(display_name="Telemetry & Token Metadata", name="telemetry", method="run_telemetry"),
    ]

    def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dict[str, Any], field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        flow_id = _resolve_flow_id(self, build_config)
        selected_fn = (
            field_value
            if field_name == "ai_function" and isinstance(field_value, str)
            else build_config.get("ai_function", {}).get("value")
            or getattr(self, "ai_function", "AI_CLASSIFY")
        ).strip().upper()
        visible = set(AI_FUNCTION_VISIBLE_FIELDS.get(selected_fn, ("input_text", "return_as_json")))
        managed_fields = (
            "input_text",
            "categories_or_schema",
            "source_lang",
            "target_lang",
            "stage_selector",
            "media_type_filter",
            "stage_file_path",
            "second_stage_file_path",
            "second_text_or_stage_file",
            "batch_directory_mode",
            "transcribe_timestamp_granularity",
            "parse_document_mode",
            "parse_document_page_split",
            "embed_model",
            "multi_embed_options_json",
            "model_for_count_tokens",
            "return_error_details",
            "return_as_json",
            "estimate_tokens",
        )
        for fname in managed_fields:
            if fname in build_config:
                build_config[fname]["show"] = fname in visible

        if selected_fn == "AI_MULTI_EMBED" and "embed_model" in build_config:
            build_config["embed_model"]["value"] = "twelvelabs-marengo-embed-3-0"

        if "stage_selector" in visible:
            stg_resp = LIVE_BRIDGE.list_stages_for_context(flow_id=flow_id)
            stg_items = stg_resp.get("stages") or []
            stg_opts = [
                str(s.get("stage_fqn") or f"@{s.get('fqn')}")
                for s in stg_items
                if isinstance(s, dict) and (s.get("stage_fqn") or s.get("fqn"))
            ]
            if not stg_opts:
                stg_opts = ["@SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW.CORE.SNOWFLAKE_LANGFLOW_STAGE"]
            if "stage_selector" in build_config:
                build_config["stage_selector"]["options"] = stg_opts
                cur_stg = build_config["stage_selector"].get("value") or stg_opts[0]
            else:
                cur_stg = stg_opts[0]
            if field_name == "stage_selector" and isinstance(field_value, str) and field_value.strip():
                cur_stg = field_value.strip()

            mfilter = (
                field_value
                if field_name == "media_type_filter" and isinstance(field_value, str)
                else build_config.get("media_type_filter", {}).get("value")
                or getattr(self, "media_type_filter", "All Compatible")
            )
            files_resp = LIVE_BRIDGE.list_stage_files(cur_stg)
            file_opts = filter_stage_files_for_function(
                files_resp.get("files") or [],
                ai_function=selected_fn,
                media_type_filter=str(mfilter),
            )
            if "stage_file_path" in build_config:
                build_config["stage_file_path"]["options"] = file_opts
            if "second_stage_file_path" in build_config:
                build_config["second_stage_file_path"]["options"] = file_opts

        return build_config

    def _build_sql(self) -> str:
        cats_or_schema = (
            getattr(self, "categories_or_schema", None)
            or getattr(self, "categories_csv", None)
            or getattr(self, "instructions", "")
            or ""
        )
        return DomainAIFunctionEngine.build_task_specific_sql(
            ai_function=self.ai_function or "AI_CLASSIFY",
            input_text=self.input_text or "",
            categories_or_schema=cats_or_schema,
            source_lang=getattr(self, "source_lang", "") or "",
            target_lang=getattr(self, "target_lang", None) or getattr(self, "instructions", "it") or "it",
            pii_categories=getattr(self, "pii_categories", "") or "",
            second_text_or_stage_file=getattr(self, "second_text_or_stage_file", "") or "",
            model_for_count_tokens=getattr(self, "model_for_count_tokens", "claude-sonnet-5-5") or "claude-sonnet-5-5",
            return_as_json=bool(getattr(self, "return_as_json", False)),
            stage_selector=getattr(self, "stage_selector", "") or "",
            stage_file_path=getattr(self, "stage_file_path", "") or "",
            second_stage_file_path=getattr(self, "second_stage_file_path", "") or "",
            batch_directory_mode=bool(getattr(self, "batch_directory_mode", False)),
            return_error_details=bool(getattr(self, "return_error_details", False)),
            transcribe_timestamp_granularity=getattr(self, "transcribe_timestamp_granularity", "default") or "default",
            parse_document_mode=getattr(self, "parse_document_mode", "LAYOUT") or "LAYOUT",
            parse_document_page_split=bool(getattr(self, "parse_document_page_split", False)),
            embed_model=getattr(self, "embed_model", "snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0") or "snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0",
            multi_embed_options_json=getattr(self, "multi_embed_options_json", "") or "",
        )

    def run_ai_function(self) -> Message:
        stmt = self._build_sql()
        res = _flow_component_execute_sql(stmt)
        if not res.get("ok"):
            raise ValueError(res.get("message", f"{self.ai_function} execution failed"))
        rows = res.get("rows", [])
        if bool(getattr(self, "batch_directory_mode", False)):
            return Message(text=json.dumps({"rows": rows, "count": len(rows)}, indent=2))
        raw_val = plain_text_result(rows[0].get("RESULT") if rows else "")
        return Message(text=str(raw_val) if not isinstance(raw_val, (dict, list)) else json.dumps(raw_val))

    def to_toolkit(self) -> list[Any]:
        """Tool Mode: one tool named after the configured AI function; the LLM supplies only the input text."""
        fn = str(self.ai_function or "AI_CLASSIFY").strip().upper()
        cfg = str(getattr(self, "categories_or_schema", "") or "").strip()

        def _invoke(input_text: str = "", **kwargs: Any) -> str:
            text = input_text or kwargs.get("tool_input") or kwargs.get("text") or ""
            if not str(text).strip():
                raise ValueError(f"{fn} tool call without input_text")
            self.input_text = str(text)
            return str(self.run_ai_function().text)

        return [
            build_structured_tool(
                name=f"snowflake_{fn.lower()}",
                description=(
                    f"Run the Snowflake Cortex AI function {fn} on the given text under the active Snowflake role."
                    + (f" Configured categories / schema / instruction: {cfg}." if cfg else "")
                ),
                func=_invoke,
                args_schema=AIFunctionToolSchema,
                metadata={"component": "SnowflakeAIFunction", "ai_function": fn, "tool_mode": True},
            )
        ]

    def run_telemetry(self) -> Data:
        return Data(
            data={
                "ai_function": self.ai_function,
                "namespace": "DIRECT_AI_*",
                "active_role": LIVE_BRIDGE.active_role,
                "return_as_json": bool(getattr(self, "return_as_json", False)),
                "batch_directory_mode": bool(getattr(self, "batch_directory_mode", False)),
                "stage_selector": getattr(self, "stage_selector", "") or "",
                "stage_file_path": getattr(self, "stage_file_path", "") or "",
                "sql_preview": self._build_sql(),
            }
        )

from typing import Any

from lfx.base.prompts.api_utils import process_prompt_template
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.inputs.input_mixin import FieldTypes
from lfx.inputs.inputs import DefaultPromptField
from lfx.io import BoolInput, MessageTextInput, Output, PromptInput
from lfx.log.logger import logger
from lfx.schema.dotdict import dotdict
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.template.utils import update_template_values
from lfx.utils.mustache_security import validate_mustache_template


class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt Template"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-prompts"
    icon = "prompts"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt Template"

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_double_brackets",
            display_name="Use Double Brackets",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
            info="Use {{variable}} syntax instead of {variable}.",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dotdict:
        """Update the template field type based on the selected mode."""
        if field_name == "use_double_brackets":
            # Change the template field type based on mode
            is_mustache = field_value is True
            if is_mustache:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.MUSTACHE_PROMPT.value
            else:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.PROMPT.value

            # Re-process the template to update variables when mode changes
            template_value = build_config.get("template", {}).get("value", "")
            if template_value:
                # Ensure custom_fields is properly initialized
                if "custom_fields" not in build_config:
                    build_config["custom_fields"] = {}

                # Clean up fields from the OLD mode before processing with NEW mode
                # This ensures we don't keep fields with wrong syntax even if validation fails
                old_custom_fields = build_config["custom_fields"].get("template", [])
                for old_field in list(old_custom_fields):
                    # Remove the field from custom_fields and template
                    if old_field in old_custom_fields:
                        old_custom_fields.remove(old_field)
                    build_config.pop(old_field, None)

                # Try to process template with new mode to add new variables
                # If validation fails, at least we cleaned up old fields
                try:
                    # Validate mustache templates for security
                    if is_mustache:
                        validate_mustache_template(template_value)

                    # Re-process template with new mode to add new variables
                    _ = process_prompt_template(
                        template=template_value,
                        name="template",
                        custom_fields=build_config["custom_fields"],
                        frontend_node_template=build_config,
                        is_mustache=is_mustache,
                    )
                except ValueError as e:
                    # If validation fails, we still updated the mode and cleaned old fields
                    # User will see error when they try to save
                    logger.debug("Template validation failed during mode switch", exc_info=e)
        return build_config

    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        use_double_brackets = self.use_double_brackets if hasattr(self, "use_double_brackets") else False
        template_format = "mustache" if use_double_brackets else "f-string"
        prompt = await Message.from_template_and_variables(template_format=template_format, **self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(prompt_template)

            custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
            frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=prompt_template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=custom_fields,
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be created
            logger.debug("Template validation failed in _update_template", exc_info=e)
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(template)

            # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be updated
            logger.debug("Template validation failed in update_frontend_node", exc_info=e)
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)
